definitions.gloss: to change color; to discolor; to fade
definitions.explanation: For something to undergo a change in color, typically due to aging, chemical reaction, heat, or exposure to light. Usually implies an undesirable change.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{変色|へんしょく}した。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{変色|へんしょく}してしまった。

⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦アボカド→アボカド：10704_abokado⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{変色|へんしょく}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦レモン{汁|じる}→レモン汁：23041_remonjiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: Cut avocado discolors when exposed to air, so it helps to squeeze lemon juice on it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧ (change) + {色|しょく} (color). Most commonly used for undesirable color changes — browning of food, fading of fabrics, yellowing of paper, or tarnishing of metals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変色|へんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ — to prevent discoloration
- {変色|へんしょく}した⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ — discolored area
- ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{変色|へんしょく}する — to discolor from heat
- ⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{変色|へんしょく}する — to discolor from UV light

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ — to change color; more casual and general, not necessarily negative
- {褪|あ}せる — to fade (of color); specifically about losing color intensity
- ⟦{黄|き}→黄：19352_ki⟧ばむ — to yellow, to turn yellowish; specific type of discoloration
